title: Active borrowers
statementMd:
List members who borrowed at least 10 books. Show name and loan count.

Expected columns: `name`, `loans`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.name, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM members m JOIN loans l ON l.member_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
